title: Existence of stage-image amalgamations on a mapped finite stage cover
statement: Under the hypotheses of the stage-image local sheaf condition, fix j, X in F(j), and R in P(j)(X). Every compatible family of stage-image sections on the mapped presieve R.map(V.ι.app j) has an amalgamation in the stage-image presheaf. Only existence on this finite stage cover is asserted, not uniqueness or the condition on arbitrary covering sieves.

    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]

    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))

    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]

    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →

proof.text: Obtain the canonical stage transition transformations from stage_section_transition_existence and evaluate them at G. Their adjunction unit equations uniquely determine these maps.

Construct the raw left-Kan-extension diagram B, its units beta, and the comparison cocone gamma using colimit_site_raw_section_diagram. Let phi be the induced presheaf colimit map to the limit inverse-image sheaf H.

The raw colimit presheaf is a sheaf by colimit_site_raw_section_isSheaf. For each stage the sheafified comparison gamma is an isomorphism: uniqueness of the composite left adjoint identifies its adjunction transpose with the canonical composition isomorphism. Sheafification preserves the colimit, and the filtered under-category is connected, so the sheafified colimit comparison is an isomorphism. The two presheaves are already sheaves; naturality of their sheafification units therefore makes phi itself an isomorphism. Use the existing private theorems raw_comparison_iso and raw_colimit_comparison_iso from ColimitSiteSetSectionEventualEquality, made accessible by a proof-only import all. These helpers prove the adjunction and connected-colimit comparisons without using that module's eventual-equality conclusion.

Apply the inverse of phi pointwise to the underlying values of x. Naturality of this inverse and compatibility of x prove compatibility of the resulting raw family x-prime. Apply the existing raw matching-lift theorem to obtain a compatible stage family y, a covering presieve T, the target equality e, and its section-image equations. No stage amalgamation is supplied by this lemma.

The stage inverse image is a sheaf, so Mathlib IsSheaf.isSheafFor_of_mem_precoverage gives an amalgamation w of y. Map w by alpha and restrict along eqToHom e.symm. The tuple (t,W,eqToHom e.symm,w) directly witnesses membership in colimitSiteStageImage. For each original covering arrow use the equality of the mapped presieve with ofArrows T to choose its stage index. Naturality of alpha and the stage gluing equation compute the restriction. Apply phi to the matching-lift image equation: the colimit coprojection equation and beta-gamma equation identify its left side with alpha(y), while phi composed with its inverse cancels on its right side. These equalities give exactly the original family value; subtype extensionality proves the required amalgamation.
